scientific_integrity: Exact theorem about the closure of the range of the unitary divisor function. Proof of tail interval uses Nagura prime-gap theorem. Fourteen intervals certified by exact rational arithmetic, not numerical approximation.
scientific_limitations: Only exponent -3. No claim of global monotonicity or classification of other parameter values. Earlier unindexed component enumerations possible. Independent audit not performed.
title: Fourteen connected components of the reciprocal-cube unitary divisor range
